question: Determine the values of $x$, $y$, $z$ and $w$ for which the matrix equation $$2\begin{bmatrix}x&1\\y&-2\end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix}1&z\\3&w\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}5&-2\\1&-7\end{bmatrix}$$ is satisfied, and verify the obtained values by substitution.
explanation:
Simplification

Multiplying the first matrix by $2$, $$2\begin{bmatrix}x&1\\y&-2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2x&2\\2y&-4\end{bmatrix}$$ Hence, $$\begin{bmatrix}2x&2\\2y&-4\end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix}1&z\\3&w\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2x-1&2-z\\2y-3&-4-w\end{bmatrix}$$ By equality of matrices, corresponding elements must be equal. Therefore, $2x-1=5$, $2-z=-2$, $2y-3=1$ and $-4-w=-7$. Solving these equations gives $2x=6$, so $x=3$; $z=4$; $2y=4$, so $y=2$; and $w=3$.

Verification

Substituting $x=3$, $y=2$, $z=4$ and $w=3$ in the left-hand side, $$2\begin{bmatrix}3&1\\2&-2\end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix}1&4\\3&3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}6&2\\4&-4\end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix}1&4\\3&3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}5&-2\\1&-7\end{bmatrix}$$ which is equal to the right-hand side. Hence, $x=3$, $y=2$, $z=4$ and $w=3$.
